topic: Cluster data consistency and client explanation
summary_markdown: The discussion confirms that the return of cluster data was requested based on observations that people frequently pass by the same screen multiple times in high-traffic areas like airports and malls. It was noted that the hourly chart for non-cluster traffic matches exactly between unique users and total traffic. The participants confirmed having previously discussed this point and decided it would not be an issue when explaining the data to clients.
decisions: The cluster data return is validated based on high foot traffic patterns in specific facilities (airports/malls).
It was agreed that discrepancies between unique user charts and total traffic charts are acceptable for client explanation.
